### 4. ESCAPE SEQUENCES & SPECIAL SYNTAX

IPython defines the following escape characters that trigger special handling:

**Defined in `inputtransformer2.py` (lines 329-337):**

| Escape | Purpose | Example | Transforms to |
|--------|---------|---------|----------------|
| `%` | Line magic | `%timeit x+1` | `get_ipython().run_line_magic('timeit', 'x+1')` |
| `%%` | Cell magic | `%%bash\necho hi` | `get_ipython().run_cell_magic('bash', '', 'echo hi\n')` |
| `!` | Shell command | `!ls -la` | `get_ipython().system('ls -la')` |
| `!!` | Shell + capture | `!!pwd` | `get_ipython().getoutput('pwd')` |
| `?` | Help (pinfo) | `obj?` | `get_ipython().run_line_magic('pinfo', 'obj')` |
| `??` | Extra help (pinfo2) | `obj??` | `get_ipython().run_line_magic('pinfo2', 'obj')` |
| `,` | Quote & call | `,myfunc a b c` | `myfunc("a", "b", "c")` |
| `;` | Quote as string | `;myfunc a b c` | `myfunc("a b c")` |
| `/` | Call with args | `/myfunc a, b, c` | `myfunc(a, b, c)` |
